name: Can I live in my home during the extension construction?

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during the extension construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can live in your home during an extension depends on the scope and nature of the project. For minor additions that are largely exterior or involve minimal disruption to essential services, it may be possible. However, for larger projects, such as second-story additions or major reconfigurations that impact kitchens, bathrooms, or primary living areas, it's often advisable and safer to relocate temporarily. We discuss this in detail during planning to minimize inconvenience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Living in your home during an extension depends on the project's scope; minor additions may allow it, but major disruptions often necessitate temporary relocation.
